reviews.text: I arrived at 9 am on Saturday and waited for half an hour but the place was closed.  Please update your working hours in google and on banner in front door.
Good care Dominika is the nicest
Everyone is very professional and kind, and the cosmetics are beautiful. My dog ​​turned out exactly as I wanted. Thank you very much Dominika!
They welcomed us with a smile 😻 …
We would like to thank Bianka for her helpfulness and professional work. She treated our timid little kitty very well. It was a very good first cosmetic experience.
Beautiful salon, nice service, they speak good English. More importantly, my dog looked really good after - much appreciated! I definitely recommend to go there with your pet! Thank you!

I've already taken my dog ​​to 1-2 dog grooming salons where they didn't really cut my dog's hair well. But thank you Viktor for doing a beautiful job! My little old warrior has never had such a nice cut.
Great place, very nice staff, a brand new puppy came out after the haircut, thank you Cinti for the professional work :)
Amazing work, we got a brand new dog back, thank you again 🙏🏼🙏🏼 …
We come here regularly with our Samoyed and we love it! The vibe is great, the staff is very professional and helpful. We recommend it to everyone!
It was a great experience to get my dog ​​groomed at your place, thank you! Everyone was super nice and my dog ​​came out looking very beautiful and smelling great!

Very good and beautiful dog grooming. Pinkie and Kissie are happy to go to Dominika every month for a haircut. She is a very good professional, she cuts the dogs very nicely. I highly recommend her to others!

This is the first beauty salon that I am completely satisfied with. The place is truly a salon where we can wait for our pets, the hospitality is great, they even offered us coffee.😍 The welcome is also very kind, it is clear that those who work here really love animals and what they do. …

I went with two dogs, the lady started with the bigger one because she thought it was easier! She was wrong! 😄 My dog ​​had her nails cut but she made the little lady sweat! I've never seen her so hysterical! The little one took it without a word!
The little lady was very patient!
Hats off! We'll be back.
Our favorite salon, great masters and a wonderful atmosphere
Best place for a dog cut :)
